description: Search the used cars currently for sale on Motor Row (Indianapolis, Indiana). All filters optional. Returns a count and up to `limit` cars, each with a plain-English summary, price, mileage, location, photos, the selling dealer's contact details, and links. Listing data was entered by the dealer and is not verified by Motor Row.

query.description: Free-text words to match against year, make, model, trim, city and description, e.g. "honda civic" or "truck 4wd".

name: search_cars
